answer: Three established peers verify one agent's single firearm license. The police registry shows the license number, the safety-course record, and a fresh signature, so a lantern of fake identities faces a reef of paperwork: a license costs $50 to $200 plus months of background checks. A thousand fakes means $50,000 to $200,000 and a thousand checks, each one waiting on a separate police review. The license renews only after a fresh background check, so a fake must keep passing the same screening. Like a garden with one gate, one license ties one agent to one record no one else can enter.
